== Title ==
<span lang="ja">グランドモフ・ターキン</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ベイダーと同じ戦闘に参加していれば、敵が運命数を求めて見せた後で、1枚だけキャンセルすることができる。彼が操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力+2になる。</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja"><u>リーダー</u>。アウターリムの統治者。デス・スター司令官。帝国元老院の解散に功があった。恐怖統治の原則を打ち立てたデス・スターを、皇帝への謀反に使おうと画策していた。</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
AI English reading aid (Memory Core ChatGPT, 7 November 2026).

'''Title'''
<blockquote>Grand Moff Tarkin</blockquote>

'''Lore'''
<blockquote>Leader. Governor of the Outer Rim. Death Star commander. Played a part in dissolving the Imperial Senate. He was plotting to use the Death Star, which established the principle of rule through fear, in a rebellion against the Emperor.</blockquote>

'''Game text'''
<blockquote>If participating in the same battle as Vader, may cancel just one card after the enemy reveals it to determine destiny. A starship he pilots gets power +2.</blockquote>

== Comparison with the original English printing ==
The Japanese lore attaches the phrase about establishing rule through fear to the [[Death Star]], while the original English gives the separate sentence "Defined doctrine of rule by fear." The Japanese game text says one card may be canceled after the enemy reveals it to determine destiny, while the English says "one opponent's destiny draw immediately after it is revealed." The printed Japanese ability label is フォース接触者; the original English label is FORCE-ATTUNED.<ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" /><ref name="english-original-face">[[:File:Premiere-D-grandmofftarkin-decipher-archive.gif|Original English Grand Moff Tarkin face]].</ref>

'''Original English lore'''
<blockquote>Leader. Governor of Outer Rim Territories. Commanded Death Star. Helped disband Imperial Senate. Defined doctrine of rule by fear. Plotted to use Death Star against Emperor.</blockquote><ref name="english-original-face" />

'''Original English game text'''
<blockquote>If with Vader in a battle, may cancel one opponent's destiny draw immediately after it is revealed. Adds 2 to power of any starship he pilots.</blockquote><ref name="english-original-face" />

== Rules ==
The November 1998 [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] states that English is the standard for tournament play, directing foreign-language cards and rules to be played and interpreted as their English counterparts under current rulings, errata and clarifications.<ref name="foreign-language-rule">[[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998), p. 62, Foreign-language cards and rules.</ref>
